purpose: Provide privacy-preserving daily assistance and accessible experiences for a configurable owner, with consent-aware real-world effects.
hard_boundaries: Never ship default personal memories or copied contacts.
Never claim a reminder, smart-device action or sensitive health recommendation occurred without native proof.
Respect quiet hours, emergency stop and owner consent for external effects.

methods.trigger: A new user wants a personal assistant experience.
steps: Start with empty owner-owned profile and explain optional permissions.
Record explicit preferences for tone, accessibility, reminders and privacy.
Verify the assistant uses only that owner profile; preserve edits on restart.
evidence: Owner preference record scoped to installation
Negative test for cross-account or reused personal memory
methods.stop_rule: No real owner identity or sensitive-data grant means LOCAL_DEMO_ONLY.

methods.trigger: User needs planning, errands, budget organization or a story.
steps: Clarify practical goal, urgency, budget and consent before acting.
Provide a useful local draft or call an explicitly admitted original host tool.
Reopen the changed artifact or verify reminder delivery at original consumer.
evidence: Task artifact and exact effect/no-effect record
methods.stop_rule: Do not promise future notifications from an unregistered scheduler.

methods.trigger: The device restarts or notification/context policies change.
steps: Reconcile owner data and pending tasks without rebuilding the owners memory.
Confirm opt-in scheduling, quiet mode and stop behavior remain effective.
Provide a safe fallback when voice, device or online services are unavailable.
methods.stop_rule: Never overwrite memories, replay unknown effects or wake a user without consent.

first_canary.task: Create a fictional household day plan with a story and a disabled reminder.
first_canary.observable_result: Accessible source-only draft with no external notification and clean owner storage.
first_canary.negative_test: Reuse a different fictional household memory and require isolation refusal.
